813-2225-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
813-2225-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Hivestone, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Scholar of the Ages token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

339-677-4785-8249.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1662-2026-2645-3430.easyPrerequisites: Voyaging Satyr doesn't have summoning sickness.
1662-2026-2645-3430.description:
Activate Karoo by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{W}{W}{W} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Voyaging Satyr by tapping it, untapping Karoo
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Voyaging Satyr.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

6495-6662-7084.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Chocobo Racetrack triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
6495-6662-7084.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to the creature with changeling

4050-4082-4640--201.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature with changeling, adding one mana.
When that creature dies, Oathkeeper triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When that creature enters, Kemba triggers, allowing you to attach Oathkeeper to that creature.
Repeat.

2946-4556-4871-6797.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2946-4556-4871-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Blight Mound trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

876-5457-7070.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Selvala.
Monk Gyatso triggers. Choose not to airbend Selvala.
Resolve Lightning Greaves' ability, attaching it to Selvala.
Activate Selvala by tapping it, adding at least {2}.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Monk Gyatso.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Selvala.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Selvala.
The Lightning Greaves ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Selvala from exile by paying {2}.
Repeat.

997-1768--5.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Juniper Order Ranger triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and Juniper Order Ranger.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

uses.n: Tetzin, Gnome Champion // The Golden-Gear Colossus

2388-3259-7292.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2388-3259-7292.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and The Golden-Gear Colossus as attackers.
The Golden-Gear Colossus triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a card exiled with it

1824-2530-2932-6710.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
1824-2530-2932-6710.description:
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
Bontu's Monument triggers, causing you to gain life and each opponent to lose life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

2440-4885-7108-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
Sokka's second ability and each Ally you control's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve all prowess triggers, giving each Ally you control +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Sokka trigger, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Ally you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally token by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature a returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
2440-4885-7108-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if you control another Ally.

38-2420-7096.easyPrerequisites: You've had a land enter this turn.
38-2420-7096.notablePrerequisites: Scuzzback Marauders does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
38-2420-7096.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Scuzzback Marauders, adding {R}.
When Scuzzback Marauders dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Bioengineered Future.
Repeat.

2103-4423-6850-6886.easyPrerequisites:
You control three other Islands.
There is another nonbasic land on the battlefield.
2103-4423-6850-6886.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Dust Bowl by paying {3}, tapping it and sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, destroying a nonbasic land.
Play Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Capture of Jingzhou during your draw step.
Repeat.

3188-4017-4186.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3188-4017-4186.description:
Gain life.
Sunbond triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

3017-3591-5796-6282.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
3017-3591-5796-6282.notablePrerequisites: You have at least eight permanent cards in your graveyard.
3017-3591-5796-6282.description:
Activate Ghostly Pilferer by discarding a card.
Necropotence triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Starving Revenant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Ghostly Pilferer ability.
Repeat.

1339-2034-2122-4772.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
1339-2034-2122-4772.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton's first ability by paying {1} and discarding a card, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Insect, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

804-2921-5756.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Sakashima the Impostor.
When Sakashima the Impostor dies, it and Havi trigger.
Resolve the Havi trigger, returning Sakashima the Impostor from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Havi.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor trigger, returning any legendary creature card with mana value 5 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1810-2084.manaNeeded: {1}{U} plus enough mana to cast the copy spell
1810-2084.description:
Cast Cackling Counterpart by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm.
Activate the Mirror-Mad Phantasm token by paying {1}{U}, shuffling the token into your library and milling your entire library due to it not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.

366-1218-4840.description:
Cast Tainted Strike by paying {B}, giving Purphoros +1/+0 and infect until end of turn.
Cast Myr Battlesphere by paying {7}.
When Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, it and Purphoros trigger.
Resolve the Myr Battlesphere trigger, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
When the Myrs enter the battlefield, Purphoros triggers four times.
Resolve all Purphoros triggers, causing each opponent to get ten poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters.

1339-2034-4365-5185.description:
Activate Tymora's Invoker by paying {8}, causing you to draw two cards.
The Locust God triggers twice, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens with flying and haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar four times by sacrificing the Insects, adding eight {C}.
Repeat.

132-198-1379-4449.notablePrerequisites: Myr Welder does not have summoning sickness.
132-198-1379-4449.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Empowered Autogenerator's ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Myr Welder and adding {R} for each charge counter on Myr Welder.
Activate Myr Welder using Hateflayer's ability by paying {2}{R} and untapping it, dealing damage equal to Myr Welder's power to any target.
Repeat.

2798-3350-4551-4827.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Axis of Mortaility triggers.
Holding priority, activate Evra by paying {4}.
Cast Humble by paying {1}{W}, causing Evra to have base power and toughness 0/1 until end of turn.
Resolve Evra's ability, swapping your life total with Evra's power.
Resolve the Axis of Mortality trigger, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero life.

190-389-810.notablePrerequisites: Magus of the Disk does not have summoning sickness.
190-389-810.description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Nine Lives and causing each opponent to create a token copy of it.
Nine Lives triggers. Holding priority, activate Magus of the Disk by paying {1} and tapping it, destroying all creatures, artifacts and enchantments.
Each opponent's Nine Lives leaves the battlefield, causing them to lose the game.

933-1494-1971.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature with power five or greater, or you own a creature with power five or greater that is exiled by Yannik.
933-1494-1971.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Yannik.
Yannik leaves the battlefield, causing any permanents exiled by it to re-enter the battlefield under their owner's control.
Yannik enters the battlefield, exiling a nontoken creature you control with power five or greater until Yannik leaves the battlefield, and putting at least five +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2369-2793-4050-4450-5089.description:
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, causing Ugin's Nexus to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by exiling Ugin's Nexus, adding one mana of any color.
Ugin's Nexus triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
Repeat.

1641-4050-4192.notablePrerequisites: "Spirit" chosen with Ashes of the Fallen.
1641-4050-4192.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Promised Kannushi, adding {G}.
Promised Kannushi's soulshift ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Promised Kannushi by paying {G}.
Repeat.

2103-2556-3632.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Cast Mnemonic Wall by paying {4}{U}.
Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Erratic Portal by paying {1} and tapping it, returning Mnemonic Wall from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
